description: Connection 2 is a FORCE connection that is not healthy (no frames of its own), so connection 1 is primary. The anomalous message of connection 2 is MALFORMED before the primary-connection label applies, and it lies in V(tau): slot NONE (MALFORMED, one void). One FORCE_MSG_STRUCTURE with conn_id=2.
title: an anomalous message on a non-primary FORCE connection, inside V(tau)
